paper_metadata.title: Tensile Properties of Cast and Hot Isostatic Pressurized Ti-6Al-4Fe-xSi Alloys

evidence.quote: The present study is to investigate the tensile properties and microstructures associated with Si content in Ti-Al-Fe-Si alloys.
